messages.body: Re-ran F1-F4 repros byte-for-byte at 046d1f8d0ff63b7193bc06e0c373ba60d9e06849 and all four are fixed; re-judged AC-1..AC-9 (all PASS, 110 tests OK) and probed new seams (marker offsets under CR/BOM, BOM+markers+CR, first-terminator choice, relative indent after depth filtering) with no defects found. Nothing blocks shipping; the latched limits are not spec defects. Python 3.11 was not run since it is not installed, so the README's 3.11 claim is checked by reading only.
